raw_response:
I farm only 5 mu, and there are just two people in the household, with some labor going off-farm, so I will keep the plan simple and steady rather than chasing anything complicated. Because my main system is cotton and I have well irrigation, I will put most of the land into cotton and keep a smaller wheat-maize rotation on the rest so I still have grain income and spread risk. I have farmed for 30 years, so I will use inputs at a moderate level: enough fertilizer to hold yield, enough irrigation to protect the crop in dry spells, and pesticide only as much as I expect I will need in a normal year. For cotton I will use hybrid seed and manage it a bit more carefully because it is my main cash crop. For wheat and maize, I will keep to the usual local pattern on the same 2 mu: wheat through winter and spring, then maize after wheat harvest in summer.
